title_i18n.es: El miembro de la Conferencia Consultiva Política del Pueblo Chino, secretario del Comité del Partido y presidente de Tongfang Co., Ltd., Han Yongjiang: propone incorporar la "IA + tecnología nuclear" en el diseño de alto nivel nacional.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 今年全国两会，全国政协委员，同方股份党委书记、董事长韩泳江围绕强化企业创新主体地位、推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合提出多项建议。他呼吁加大人工智能在安检安保、工业、农业、医疗等领域的赋能应用，建议将“AI+核技术”纳入国家层面顶层设计，配套相应政策与资源支持，加快推动我国核技术应用产业实现跨越式发展。（证券时报）
excerpt_i18n.en: During this year's National Two Sessions, Han Yongjiang, a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and Party Secretary and Chairman of Tongfang Co., Ltd., put forward multiple proposals focusing on strengthening the role of enterprises as the main drivers of innovation and promoting the deep integration of technological innovation with industrial innovation. He called for increased application of artificial intelligence in fields such as security inspection, industry, agriculture, and healthcare. He also suggested incorporating "AI + nuclear technology" into the national-level top-level design, supported by corresponding policies and resources, to accelerate the leapfrog development of China's nuclear technology application industry. (Securities Times)
excerpt_i18n.es: En las Dos Sesiones de este año, Han Yongjiang, miembro del Comité Nacional de la Conferencia Consultiva Política del Pueblo Chino y secretario del comité del partido y presidente de Tongfang Co., presentó varias propuestas centradas en fortalecer el papel de las empresas como protagonistas de la innovación y promover la integración profunda entre la innovación científica-tecnológica y la industrial. Hizo un llamado para potenciar la aplicación de la inteligencia artificial en áreas como la seguridad en inspecciones, la industria, la agricultura y la atención médica, sugiriendo incorporar la "IA + tecnología nuclear" en el diseño de alto nivel a nivel nacional, acompañado de políticas y recursos de apoyo correspondientes, para acelerar el desarrollo exponencial de la industria de aplicaciones de tecnología nuclear en China. (Securities Times)

Recently, iCAR collaborated with Horizon Robotics to host the iCAR V27 & Horizon HSD Pioneer Experience Event. Leiphone's "New Auto Intelligence" was invited to experience the assisted driving capabilities of the iCAR V27, set to launch on March 13, in Beijing.  
Flagship Computing Power + True Single-Stage End-to-End  
Prior to the hands-on experience, Horizon Robotics introduced the hardware and software configuration of the iCAR V27, as well as the development journey of Horizon HSD.  
In terms of hardware, the iCAR V27 is equipped with Horizon Robotics' Journey 6P chip, offering a single-chip computing power of 560 TOPS, paired with 27 high-precision sensors (including LiDAR). Ample computing power redundancy reserves space for long-term OTA evolution of the vehicle.  
On the software side, Horizon HSD adopts China's first mass-produced true single-stage end-to-end system. If traditional rule-based algorithms are likened to mechanical splicing of different control modules, the single-stage end-to-end approach achieves ultra-low latency from photon input to trajectory output. The system is 42% faster than the average human reaction time, enabling quicker responses to unexpected situations. The deeply coupled longitudinal and lateral control of the single-stage end-to-end system reduces undesirable behaviors such as light braking, hard braking, and "weaving" by over 90%, minimizing motion sickness. It also enhances performance in lane changes, cornering, and obstacle avoidance.

items.title: Step 3.5 Flash 在海外杀疯了！“小龙虾”全球第一，阶跃星辰把开源卷到新高度
items.raw_excerpt: 昨日全面开源后，阶跃星辰新一代基座模型 Step 3.5 Flash 的全球热度进一步攀升，模型调用量在 OpenClaw （被网友称为“小龙虾”的全球知名开源项目）上已迅速攀升至全球第一。前五名中，紧随其后的是 MiniMax M2.5、Trinity Large Preview（free）、Kimi K2.5，以及 Claude Sonnet 4.6——来自中国大模型创业公司的基座模型占据了过半席位。 有海外开发者认为，这款模型的开源力度在现阶段大模型市场中“十分罕见”，因为模型公司的惯常做法是开源成品模型（这样开发者能够做直接部署，但自由度不高）。而阶跃星辰算法团队不仅开源了 Step 3.5 Flash 模型，还开源了这款 Agent 基座模型的预训练权重（Base）、中训练权重（Midtrain）以及配套的 Steptron 训练框架。大模型训练过程中，预训练阶段主要解决模型的常识问题，让模型建立起对世界的基础认知；中训练阶段进一步强化模型高级专项能力，比如推理、代码、工具调用等，目前市场上 Agent 的能力差异也主要取决于中训练阶段的处理方式。阶跃星辰同时开源这两部分权重，意味着不仅支持开发者更灵活二次开发，更考虑到开发社区实际需求，为其提供更多元选项。结合开源的官方同款训练框架以及此前公开的技术报告，开发者能够以 Step 3.5 Flash 为基座，进行更极致创新与探索。 目前，阶跃星辰已在 GitHub 提供 OpenClaw 接入教程，详情请见  https://github.com/stepfun-ai/Step-3.5-Flash/tree/main/cookbooks/openclaw。

excerpt_i18n.en: Following its full open-source release yesterday, the global popularity of Step 3.5 Flash, the new-generation base model from StepFun, has continued to rise. Its usage on OpenClaw (a globally renowned open-source project nicknamed "Crayfish" by netizens) has quickly climbed to the top worldwide. In the top five rankings, it is followed by MiniMax M2.5, Trinity Large Preview (free), Kimi K2.5, and Claude Sonnet 4.6—with base models from Chinese AI startups occupying over half of the spots. Some overseas developers believe the extent of this model's open-source release is "quite rare" in the current large model market, as model companies typically open-source only finished models (which developers can deploy directly but with limited flexibility). In contrast, StepFun's algorithm team has not only open-sourced the Step 3.5 Flash model but also released the pre-training weights (Base), mid-training weights (Midtrain), and the accompanying Steptron training framework for this Agent base model. During large model training, the pre-training phase primarily addresses the model's common-sense knowledge, establishing a foundational understanding of the world. The mid-training phase further enhances the model's advanced specialized capabilities, such as reasoning, coding, and tool invocation. Currently, differences in Agent capabilities in the market largely depend on the handling of the mid-training phase. StepFun has open-sourced both sets of weights simultaneously.

items.raw_excerpt: 要闻提示 1.OpenAI 与美国防部合作惹众怒：ChatGPT 卸载量大增 295%，一星评价暴涨 775% 2.比亚迪车在以色列扛住了一枚导弹！车身完好没起火，乘客仅轻伤 3.马云与阿里、蚂蚁核心管理层罕见齐聚谈AI 4.李开复谈“Anthropic 指责中国蒸馏 AI 模型”：小题大做，这公司还欠我 3000 美元稿费 5.百度智能云技术委员会主席孙珂离职 6.演员吐槽5家AI答案不一！百度、千问唱反调，豆包最有意思 7.亚马逊中东地区多个数据中心遭无人机袭击，导致 AWS 业务中断 8.iPhone17褪色遭集体投诉？苹果：暂未收到大量反馈，如出现褪色可前往直营店检测处理 今日头条 OpenAI 与美国防部合作惹众怒：ChatGPT 卸载量大增 295%，一星评价暴涨 775% 3 月 3 日消息，据外媒报道，近日，OpenAI与美国国防部达成合作，而消费端的反应来得又快又直接。数据显示，2 月 28 日（周六），ChatGPT 移动应用在美国的单日卸载量环比激增 295%。相比之下，过去 30 天内，ChatGPT 的日均环比卸载率约为 9%。 与此同时，OpenAI 竞争对手 Anthropic 在宣布不与美国国防部合作后，旗下 AI 产品 Claude 在 2 月 27 日（周五） 美国的单日下载量在周五环比飙升 37%，周六再涨 51%。Anthropic 表示，因担忧 AI 技术将被用于监控美国公民及开发完全自主武器系统，双方未能就合作条款达成共识，因为当前 AI 尚不具备安全实现此类应用的能力。这些数据显示，不少消费者似乎更认同 Anthropic 在此事上的立场。 此外，ChatGPT 的下载量也因 OpenAI 与美国防部合作的消息受到影响。在该协议公开后的次日（周六），其美国市场单日下载量环比下降 13%，周日延续跌势再降 5%
